answer: NOAA provides water level data and satellite surface water temperature data. Water levels have fluctuated since 1860 and declined in most lakes over recent decades; average surface temperatures have increased slightly since 1995. Warmer water contributes to lower levels by increasing evaporation and delaying ice formation.
